subject: website
name: Feng Ling
summary: Feng Ling's academic site: hand-written HTML pages served as written, so the source is public (no licence file). It runs no third-party code and, when it opens, reaches only its own files (fonts and KaTeX styles are now bundled). It has no server-backed actions. External links only open when clicked. Level 4 with privacy.

operations.name: Read papers and figures
operations.note: Static pages, images and local scripts for diagrams; nothing is fetched from elsewhere.

operations.name: Play the training video
operations.note: Video is a local file, loaded only when the reader presses play.
